## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes tests for behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] Privacy-sensitive data is absent from code, tests, logs, and screenshots.
- [ ] Permission, provider-policy, persistence, and release impacts are stated.
- [ ] Relevant wiki pages and `docs/wiki/INDEX.md` are synchronized.
- [ ] Changed local Markdown links resolve.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and unverified device behavior are explicit.
